approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: The current RFI role pattern accepts a role word as any line prefix, so Request for Information is relabeled QUESTION and Response time is relabeled RESPONSE.
Require an explicit role word to end the heading or be followed by the existing colon, hash or dash separator; keep supported inline role text after that separator.
Change the shared deterministic pattern only; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Exact RFI role heading boundaries
objective: Prevent ordinary lines that merely begin with Request, Question, Response, Answer or Reply from manufacturing an RFI role while preserving explicit role headings.
